title: Chief of Staff
description: Company Description Songo Design & Build PLC is a design-and-build company based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, offering an integrated approach that combines design, costing, and construction within a single contract and team. The company emphasizes accountability and clarity, providing one responsible party from the initial sketch through a twelve-month post-handover visit. Projects follow a structured, 21-stage program, each with a signed gate to document progress, quality, and decisions. Songo delivers finishing to shop-drawing standards, ensuring all materials and samples are approved before use, and manages the specification, sourcing, and clearance of imported finishing materials in-house. Guided by the ethos “Imagination, engineered,” the company values collaborative decision-making and thorough project execution. Role Description The Chief of Staff role at Songo Design & Build PLC is a full-time, on-site position based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The Chief of Staff will support the executive leadership by coordinating strategic initiatives, tracking key projects, and ensuring alignment between design, cost, and construction teams. This role involves structuring and facilitating leadership meetings, preparing briefings and reports, managing follow-ups on decisions, and maintaining clear communication across departments. The Chief of Staff will help improve internal processes, monitor performance against company milestones, and proactively identify risks or bottlenecks in the project pipeline. The role also includes building relationships with internal and external stakeholders, supporting resource planning, and acting as a trusted advisor to leadership to keep priorities on schedule and on budget. Qualifications Strong strategic planning, project management, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and deadlines. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills to work effectively across design, engineering, construction, and finance teams. Analytical and problem-solving abilities, including experience with data-driven decision-making, performance tracking, and process improvement. Leadership and people-management capabilities, including facilitating meetings, guiding cross-functional work, and supporting change management. Experience in construction, architecture, engineering, or real estate development is highly beneficial; familiarity with design-and-build delivery models is a plus. Bachelor’s degree in business, management, engineering, architecture, or a related field; an advanced degree (e.g., MBA) is an advantage. High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling confidential information and sensitive decisions. Comfort working on-site in Addis Ababa and engaging directly with project teams, clients, and partners. Experiance General experience : 6 years, 3 of them in a construction, engineering or property company Specific experience: At least 4 years as executive or personal assistant to a chief executive, general manager or director, preferably in construction, engineering or professional services Evidence required : Two references from executives served; a sample of minutes and a formatted letter; employment certificates with dates

title: HR Manager
description: Company Description ZIONS is a premium café and pastry brand based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, focused on creating exceptional food and beverage experiences for everyday moments and special occasions. The company offers a wide range of cakes, pastries, desserts, cookies, ice cream, packaged coffee, and beverages, prepared with quality ingredients and a commitment to creativity and consistency. With a growing branch network, including Summit Fiyel’Bet, Lebu, Summit Pepsi, and a fourth branch opening soon, ZIONS is expanding its presence in Addis Ababa. The organization’s team of around 230 employees works together to deliver welcoming service, reliable quality, and memorable customer experiences across dine-in, takeaway, delivery, and corporate orders. ZIONS is dedicated to bringing people together through thoughtfully made products and services “with a touch of love.” Role Description The HR Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Addis Ababa, responsible for overseeing all human resources functions across ZIONS’ branches and central operations. This role includes managing recruitment and onboarding processes, supporting workforce planning, and coordinating training and development initiatives to help team members grow and perform effectively. The HR Manager will administer HR policies and procedures, handle performance management cycles, and support employee relations, including conflict resolution and engagement activities. This position also involves maintaining accurate HR records, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and company standards, and partnering with leadership to foster a positive, inclusive workplace culture. The HR Manager will collaborate closely with branch managers and department leads to ensure staffing needs are met and HR practices align with business goals. Qualifications Demonstrated experience in core HR functions such as recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations. Strong skills in HR administration, including record-keeping, policy implementation, and compliance with local labor laws and regulations. Ability to design and support training, coaching, and development programs that enhance employee skills and engagement. Effective communication, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to work respectfully with diverse teams. Solid organizational and time-management abilities, including attention to detail and capacity to manage multiple branches or locations. Proficiency with HR systems or software and basic office tools (e.g., spreadsheets, word processing, HRIS platforms). Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage. Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a senior HR role, preferably in hospitality, retail, or service-oriented environments. Commitment to ethical, non-discriminatory HR practices and fostering an inclusive, supportive workplace culture. Fluency
